info.description:
The course consists of 12
chapters. In one chapter are 2 reading passages with the same theme, presented
in 6 parts: 
Before you read, reading
skill, reading comprehension, critical thinking, vocabulary comprehension 
and
 vocabulary skill
. The aim of the course
is to provide students with advanced-level language as well as social and
natural knowledge regarding to such topics as work, computer, travel, mind,
food, language, culture, literature and wildlife. Through the reading practice
during the course, students are also equipped themselves with reading skills as
follows:
-
Skimming
-
Scanning
-
Predicting

-
Understanding inferences
